project_type: Python WiFi reconnaissance and attack framework (security tool)
test_framework: None (no test files exist in the project)
verification_instructions: 1. Validate Python syntax with ast.parse. 2. Check that all referenced module classes/methods exist in the codebase.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - tkinter is Python stdlib. scapy and manuf are dependencies but not needed for GUI code validation.
environment_constraints: tkinter module is NOT importable in this sandbox (no X11/display). Validation must be done via ast.parse() and static analysis only. Cannot run the GUI. The code must be syntactically valid Python that will work when tkinter is available on the target system.
contribution_requirements: Commit to existing branch fix/complete-audit-fixes. Push to update PR #1.
key_patterns: All engines follow start()/stop() pattern with self.running flag. Database uses POSDatabase class with get_stats(), get_clients_for_bssid(), get_pos_access_points(), get_all_ap_clients(). Config provides IS_WINDOWS, IS_LINUX, log, interface defaults. Engines use threading for background work.
directory_structure: Root: setup.py, README.md, run.py. All framework code in posframework/ package. 36 modules covering recon, attacks, MITM, credential harvesting, and printer exploitation.
